scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @chess-room/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @chess-room/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @chess-room/server && npm run build --workspace @chess-room/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:check: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U chess_room -d chess_room -c "SELECT version();"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @chess-room/contracts && npm run build --workspace @chess-room/game-core
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
